note: Set A binds the wiring-schedule symbols to their conductor specs correctly (20→3#12/#12G, 50→3#6/#8G, 150→AL 3#4/0, 32→2#10USE-2, 33/34→6#10 variants) and correctly reads the notes (50A/2P main breaker, 200A/2P NFDS, 60A DC NFDS, NEMA 3R enclosures, junction box, revisions, lot number). Set B makes a serious misbinding by assigning the 200A/2P rating to the SUB-PANEL main breaker (the note gives 50A/2P; 200A/2P is the NFDS), downgrades NEMA 3R to "NEMA 3" twice, and introduces three wire specs (101, 105, 106) that appear nowhere on the page. Set A's flaws are a garbled/misbound "MAIN BREAKER ... WITH GROUND FAULT" quote (ground fault belongs to the 2.8kW inverter) and an unsupported "component 2 connected to ground" claim. Set B does capture the 120/240V sub-panel voltage and the 60A DC NFDS, but its invented and misbound claims outweigh that.
